topic: a cluttered basement turned into a sports den by one custom prompt
headline: Empty basement? Game on.
visualSummary: Square format. Pale periwinkle field with a fine dot texture and a thin border frame. Huge uppercase outlined headline top left in navy then bright blue, with a football emoji at the right. One large photo card split left to right by a hand drawn wavy navy divider, cluttered wood panelled basement on the left and a finished sports den with a bar, swivel chairs, framed jerseys and a neon sign on the right. Dark BEFORE and blue AFTER pills at the top corners. A white speech bubble callout over the left photo. White footer card with a line of copy and a blue Free at Stagify.ai button.

topic: turning a floor plan into a photoreal room before the house exists
headline: Sell it before it's built.
visualSummary: A solid brand blue header bar across the top with a white uppercase headline and the Stagify wordmark. The frame is then split into two full width horizontal panels. The top panel is a top down floor plan render on a faint blue grid with a blue FLOOR PLAN pill. The bottom panel is the same space as a photoreal three quarter interior render with a blue AI RENDER pill, showing a fireplace, seating and a canopy bed. A white rounded caption pill sits across the bottom of the lower panel. Cool greys, pale oak and soft blue throughout.

topic: the whole upload to staged flow told as a three panel story
headline: The empty listing
visualSummary: A comic strip. Navy header bar with a white uppercase title and a small letterspaced subtitle, plus a blue starburst badge reading ONE CLICK top right. Three stacked panels with thick navy borders on a pale blue field. Panel one is an empty room photo with a flat illustrated stick figure and a white speech bubble. Panel two is a dotted field with the figure holding a phone, a drawn swoosh arrow, and a navy caption block. Panel three is a fully staged midcentury bedroom with a blue STAGED starburst and a disclosure pill. A solid blue footer bar carries the call to action and a middot separated feature line.

topic: an empty room does not sell and staging fixes it in seconds
headline: Empty rooms don't sell.
visualSummary: Top to bottom split rather than left to right. White headline and pale blue subhead sit over a blue gradient wash on the upper photo of an empty white brick room. A jagged zigzag bright blue band cuts across the middle carrying the letterspaced words 8 SECONDS. Below it the same room staged coastal with a teal painted brick wall, white slipcovered sofa, rattan armchairs and framed seascapes. Small white BEFORE and AFTER pills on the left edge of each half. A white footer card with a navy line of copy and a blue Stagify.ai pill, then a small centred tagline.

topic: watching an empty luxury room furnish itself in eight seconds
headline: 8 seconds ago, this room was empty.
visualSummary: Full bleed photo of a luxury living room with a cream sectional, marble coffee table, gold and black triptych and a sputnik chandelier. A soft vertical light seam near the right edge reveals the empty version of the same room behind a blue tinted dotted scrim, so the reveal runs vertically instead of diagonally. Large white uppercase two line headline across the top. Three small white pills along the bottom left reading STYLE LUXURY, a timer, and 1 CLICK, with a disclosure pill bottom right. A pale blue footer band carries a navy line, a grey line and the wordmark.

topic: a cluttered dining room emptied before it is staged
headline: They won’t declutter. Stage it anyway.
visualSummary: Full bleed dining room split by a steep bright blue diagonal wipe running from the lower left to the upper right. Left of the line the room is cluttered with boxes, bottles and papers across the table and sideboard. Right of the line the same room is cleared and staged with a set table and upholstered chairs. Dark BEFORE pill top left, white logo pill top right, blue AFTER pill at the lower right above the button. Two line headline bottom left over a dark scrim. Warm oak and olive against the blue chrome.

topic: one spare room shown as three different uses
headline: What is this room for?
visualSummary: A five slide deep blue swipe deck. Slide one is a tight crop of a completely empty room, white walls, pale oak floor, a window at the left and a door at the right, under a dark scrim with the question what is this room for and a swipe chevron. Slides two, three and four each sit on the deep blue field with a short line, a note and one rounded photo card of the same room staged as an office, then a guest room, then a reading room, each carrying a use pill. The window, radiator, sill, cornice, doorway and floorboards are identical in all three. Slide five is the deep blue closing field with the ask and a single white pill. Warm chalk white and pale oak against the blue chrome.

topic: what agents say curb appeal is worth on a listing
headline: 97% of agents say curb appeal brings the buyer.
visualSummary: A type first card on the deep blue field. A very large brand blue numeral 97 with a smaller percent sign, a white claim line under it, a muted support sentence and a small source line naming the NAR report. Across the lower third a wide photo band showing a red brick house facade in raking golden hour light, arched upper windows, a gabled entry canopy and a porch lamp, with a strip of clear blue sky at the left. A small pill on the band reads GOLDEN HOUR.

topic: what the free tier actually gives you before a card is asked for
headline: Free is not a teaser.
visualSummary: Two stacked panels on the deep blue field. The top panel is muted red and carries the belief that free means a watermarked preview, with a short concession under it. The bottom panel is brand blue and states that free means the finished file, with a note naming what is included and what is not. Sitting inside the right edge of the blue panel, faded in from the left, is a warm crop of a midcentury kitchen render: a cream retro range with chrome trim and six knobs, a cream fridge, patterned cream and gold tile, amber oak cabinets and a sliver of fruit bowl on the counter.

topic: putting the furniture you already own into the staged photo
headline: Stage it with the sofa you are keeping.
visualSummary: Deep blue editorial field. Letterspaced FURNITURE REFERENCE eyebrow with the logo lockup at the top, then a two tone headline and a line of setup. Below it two rounded photo cards stacked vertically, each a wide horizontal band holding one sofa at almost the same scale, which is the whole point of the frame. The upper card is a Stagify render of a luxury living room cropped to the seating: a deep aubergine button tufted velvet sofa with two ivory cushions, flanked by walnut side tables and tall brass and glass lamps, two gilt picture frames above, a marble and walnut coffee table with cut glass decanters across the front. The lower card is the owner's own photograph of that same aubergine tufted sofa with two white cushions, shot straight on against white panelled doors with antiqued mirror glass. Small blue pills read STAGED and YOUR SOFA. Aubergine, walnut, ivory and brass against the blue chrome.
